laws.rule: Bihar has total prohibition. Under s 37 of the Bihar Prohibition and Excise Act 2016, as amended in 2022, a person caught drinking or drunk is arrested and taken before an Executive Magistrate; a first offender can be released on paying the notified penalty (reported as INR 2,000 to 5,000), or serve one month if not paid. Repeat offences can bring prison.
